About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Vemuram Rage e Back to results Vemuram Rage e Overdrive Distortion Brass-body overdrive/distortion with a footswitchable boost and a side-mounted gain trimmer. The Rage e is a Vemuram overdrive/distortion built to add harmonic depth, long sustain and a three-dimensional, saturated character, housed in the brand's machined brass body. It uses dual noiseless footswitches, one for bypass and one for a boost that lifts volume and saturation for solos, plus a side-mounted gain trimmer for fine-tuning the distortion range. The result is a versatile, expressive drive that spans overdrive to full distortion with a premium, road-ready build.
